'''Scimitar 1''' was a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]]<ref name="SWCCG" /> manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]].<ref name="DB" /> By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' establishes that the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] take place in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. {{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Scimitar 1}} is concurrent to the events of ''Return of the Jedi''; therefore, its [[in-universe]] [[Standard year/Legends|year]] is also 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> the [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] was part of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy's]] [[Scimitar Squadron (Imperial)/Legends|Scimitar Squadron]],<ref name="SWCCG" /> an elite bomber [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]].<ref name="Rhymer" /> Scimitar 1 was equipped with an advanced [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting system]] to increase damage during [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombardment]].<ref name="SWCCG" />

Scimitar 1 was flown by the [[TIE pilot]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Rhymer/Legends|Rhymer]], who led Scimitar Squadron.<ref name="Rhymer" /> Prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Rhymer and the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] were stationed in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]] and were tasked with destroying any ground [[Troop/Legends|troops]] or equipment that might land on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]],<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|11|END 7-10|The Battle of Endor}}</ref> which contained the [[Endor shield generator bunker|shield generator]] protecting the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[2000]], Scimitar 1 was created for ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'', an expansion set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="SWCCG" />
